citations.assessment: The testimony passage has Giddel bar Minyaymin in this digital witness. This corroborates an occurrence of the first patronym with a spelling variation.

citations.assessment: Gittin names Abaye bar Binyamin in the priestly blessing teaching. The parallel in Berakhot reads בי רבי rather than בר. Neither passage ties the two patronyms in Heilprin’s entry to one father.
